latest_canonical_articles.title: Winning First Is Not Winning: Roche's Divarasib Pushes KRAS Into a Generational Elimination Race
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Roche's divarasib beat first-generation KRAS G12C inhibitors in a head-to-head Phase III study, moving the RAS field from proving druggability to replacing earlier products with harder clinical evidence.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 先贏不是贏：Roche divarasib 把 KRAS 賽道推進世代淘汰戰
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Roche 的 divarasib 在頭對頭三期試驗中擊敗第一代 KRAS G12C 抑制劑，代表 RAS 賽道已從證明可成藥，進入用臨床硬終點淘汰上一代產品的競爭。

latest_canonical_articles.title: 社恐神藥三期踩煞車：Fasedienol 不是輸在故事，而是輸在 CNS 新藥最難證明的一格
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 一款藥最迷人的時候，常常也是它最危險的時候：市場先愛上故事，臨床才慢慢追問證據。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Fasedienol's Phase 3 Brake: The Story Did Not Fail. The CNS Evidence Bar Did Its Job.
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Fasedienol's PALISADE-4 miss was not simply a failed Phase 3 headline. It exposed the core CNS drug-development problem: a beautiful mechanism and a real unmet need still have to survive subjective endpoints, placebo response, patient selection, and a commercial repositioning test.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Sobi's NASP Received an FDA CRL: The Problem Was Manufacturing Credibility, Not Efficacy
latest_canonical_articles.summary: FDA identified no clinical efficacy or safety concerns that affected NASP's approvability. The setback centered on CMC controls and contract-manufacturing deficiencies, showing biotech investors why manufacturing credibility becomes part of asset value near launch.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 痛風新藥被 FDA 打回票：NASP 沒輸在療效，而是卡在製造可信度
latest_canonical_articles.summary: FDA 並未指出影響 NASP 核准可能性的臨床療效或安全性問題，真正要求補強的是 CMC 控制策略與委託製造設施缺失。這封 CRL 提醒投資人：越接近上市，製造可信度越是藥品價值的一部分。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Why Has Japan Struggled to Build Global-Scale Biotech Companies?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Japan has strong science, major pharmaceutical companies, and a large drug market. The harder question is why that foundation has not produced more global-scale biotech startups. The answer is not scientific weakness, but an ecosystem gap across assets, talent, capital, clinical execution, and exits.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 日本為什麼長不出全球級 Biotech？問題不在科學，而在產業生態
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 日本不是缺少科學，也不是缺少大藥廠，而是缺少把大學技術、人才、資本、臨床與 BD 串成全球級 Biotech 的連續生態。

latest_canonical_articles.title: GLP-1's Second Half: Why Dorzagliatin Is About Making Metabolic Therapy Last
latest_canonical_articles.summary: GLP-1 competition is moving from peak weight loss toward long-term use, tolerability, rebound control, and combination design. Dorzagliatin matters not as a GLP-1 replacement, but as a possible metabolic base for the next phase of chronic therapy.

latest_canonical_articles.title: GLP-1 下半場：dorzagliatin（多格列艾汀）想解決的，不是減重更猛，而是長期用得住
latest_canonical_articles.summary: GLP-1 競爭進入長期維持與聯用下半場，dorzagliatin 的價值不在取代減重藥，而是可能成為代謝治療的可持續底座。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Pfizer's ADC Bet: Why 3SBio's PD-1/VEGF Bispecific Has Become the New Pivot
latest_canonical_articles.summary: After a Phase III setback for sigvotatug vedotin, Pfizer's $43 billion Seagen ADC bet is increasingly tied to whether 3SBio's PD-1/VEGF bispecific can become a new immuno-oncology combination backbone.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 【輝瑞 ADC 賭局：430 億美元買下 Seagen 之後，為什麼 3SBio 的 PD-1/VEGF 雙抗變成新支點？】
latest_canonical_articles.summary: sigvotatug vedotin Phase III 單藥失利後，輝瑞的 430 億美元 Seagen ADC 賭局正轉向 3SBio PD-1/VEGF 雙抗與聯合療法底座。

latest_canonical_articles.title: 通用型 CAR-T 的 2026 從低谷回暖
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 邏輯很簡單：傳統自體 CAR-T 需要取出患者自己的 T 細胞，送到工廠改造、擴增、檢驗，再回輸到患者體內。療效可以很強，但等待時間長、成本高、製程複雜，病情進展太快或 T 細胞品質太差的患者，常常等不到治療。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Off-the-Shelf CAR-T in 2026: Rebounding From the Trough
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR-T is no longer just a beautiful manufacturing story. In 2026, better clinical signals and clearer positioning are bringing the field back to the table.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 半年併購 1,340 億美元：Big Pharma 到底在搶什麼？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 2026 年才過一半，全球製藥業的併購節奏已經快到讓人有點恍神。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Big Pharma's $134 Billion M&A Rush: What Is It Really Buying?
latest_canonical_articles.summary: In the first half of 2026, Big Pharma's biotech M&A pace has accelerated sharply. The real question is not why large drugmakers have cash, but why they are suddenly less willing to wait.

latest_canonical_articles.title: Operation TrialBlazer: Why HHS Is Rewriting Clinical-Trial Rules and Biotech Competition
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Operation TrialBlazer is not just an FDA efficiency program. It signals that the United States is treating clinical-trial speed as part of national biotech competitiveness, with direct implications for biotech valuation, financing windows, and regulatory strategy.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 美國 HHS 啟動 Operation TrialBlazer：臨床試驗規則要變了，新藥競爭也要變了
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 2026 年 6 月 22 日，美國衛生與公共服務部，也就是 HHS，啟動了一項名為 Operation TrialBlazer 的部門級臨床試驗改革計畫。

latest_canonical_articles.title: RevMed Says No to Being Bought: Biotech's Independent Era
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Revolution Medicines is choosing not to make a sale its priority. The decision reflects a broader shift: top-tier biotech companies with breakthrough assets may once again have a credible path to grow into independent biopharma companies.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 拒絕被併購的 RevMed：Biotech 的獨立時代
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 圍繞 Revolution Medicines（RevMed）的併購傳聞，一直沒有真正停過。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Synthetic Lethality After PARP: Why the Next Oncology Blockbuster Has Been So Hard to Find
latest_canonical_articles.summary: PARP inhibitors turned synthetic lethality into a commercial reality. Two decades later, the industry is still asking why the next PARP-like blockbuster has been so difficult to reproduce.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 合成致死二十年：為什麼 PARP 之後，下一個神藥遲遲沒有出現？
latest_canonical_articles.summary: 2005 年，《Nature》兩篇經典研究把 BRCA／PARP 這組關係推上舞台。

latest_canonical_articles.title: Centanafadine’s Phase 3b Win: Why ADHD Treatment Is Moving Beyond Discipline and Toward Neurobiology
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Otsuka’s centanafadine has reported positive Phase 3b data in adults with ADHD and comorbid anxiety. The FDA has accepted the NDA and granted priority review, making the program a useful lens for how ADHD treatment is shifting from behavioral stigma toward more precise neurobiological intervention.

latest_canonical_articles.title: 摒棄「鐵拳教育」：ADHD 新藥 centanafadine IIIb 期成功，上市只差臨門一腳
latest_canonical_articles.summary: Otsuka 的 ADHD 新藥 centanafadine 公布成人 ADHD 合併焦慮症 IIIb 期積極結果，FDA 已接受 NDA 並給予優先審查。這不只是新藥進度，也反映 ADHD 治療正在從單一路徑走向更多機制與病人分層。
